changes.rationale: User reported automatic demo recording, marker disappearance after rapid pause/end/new-walk, and pixel-map failure on iPhone. Define additional regression cases before fixes.
changes.impact: Retains every existing scenario and planned status. Adds domain cases for idle Start, position retention, native document-state replay and optional-cache fallback; does not certify physical WebView or full M1 behavior.
changes.review: Hanan must review expected behavior and phone retest evidence; no review or milestone completion claimed.
